# Shape and space (`shape-space`)

Radii, spacing and touch targets from the theme character.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`applyTheme` (types in `dist/web/theme.d.ts`): Applies a theme to an element (default `<html>`) as inline CSS variables, and records it in `data-mh-theme`, `data-mh-device`, `data-mh-mode`, `data-mh-corners` and `data-mh-depth` for CSS to key on. Returns the resolved tokens. Pages that only need a built-in theme can skip this and set `data-mh-theme` themselves (themes.css).

```ts
export function applyTheme(theme: Theme | string, options: ApplyThemeOptions = {}, target: HTMLElement = document.documentElement): Tokens;

export interface ApplyThemeOptions {
  /** Default `phone`. */
  deviceClass?: DeviceClass;
  /** Override parts of the theme's character: corners, density, depth, glow, outline, backdrop, outlined. */
  character?: Partial<Character>;
  /** A named accent in place of the theme's own. */
  accent?: AccentName | 'default';
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { applyTheme } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const tokens = applyTheme('daylight', { deviceClass: 'phone', character: { density: 'compact' } });

// Prefer the variables: they follow the theme's corners and density.
const tile = document.createElement('div');
tile.textContent = 'Bedroom';
Object.assign(tile.style, {
  padding: 'var(--mh-space-md)',
  borderRadius: 'var(--mh-radius-lg)',
  minHeight: 'var(--mh-control-lg)',
  background: 'var(--mh-surface-raised)',
});

// The numbers are there for layout done in code.
const gap = tokens.space.sm;
const columns = Math.max(1, Math.floor((window.innerWidth + gap) / (160 + gap)));
const grid = document.createElement('div');
Object.assign(grid.style, {
  display: 'grid',
  gap: `${gap}px`,
  gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, 1fr)`,
});
grid.append(tile);

document.body.append(grid);
```

## React API

`ThemeProvider` (types in `dist/react/theme.d.ts`): Applies a theme (as `applyTheme` does) and provides its resolved tokens to `useTokens()`.

```ts
export function ThemeProvider({ theme, deviceClass, character, accent, scope = 'document', className, children }: ThemeProviderProps);

export interface ThemeProviderProps {
  /** A built-in theme id or a theme object. */
  theme: Theme | string;
  deviceClass?: DeviceClass;
  character?: Partial<Character>;
  accent?: AccentName | 'default';
  /** Apply to `<html>` (default) or to a wrapping `<div>` (several themes on one page). */
  scope?: 'document' | 'local';
  className?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`useTokens` (types in `dist/react/theme.d.ts`): The resolved tokens of the nearest `ThemeProvider` (for values CSS can't reach: canvas drawing, charts).

```ts
export function useTokens(): Tokens;
```

## React example

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, useTokens } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Office'];

function RoomGrid() {
  // The numbers are there for layout done in code; the variables follow corners and density in CSS.
  const { space } = useTokens();
  const columns = Math.max(1, Math.floor((window.innerWidth + space.sm) / (160 + space.sm)));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: space.sm, gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, 1fr)` }}>
      {rooms.map((room) => (
        <div
          key={room}
          style={{
            padding: 'var(--mh-space-md)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--mh-radius-lg)',
            minHeight: 'var(--mh-control-lg)',
            background: 'var(--mh-surface-raised)',
          }}
        >
          {room}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ShapeSpaceExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme="daylight" deviceClass="phone" character={{ density: 'compact' }}>
      <RoomGrid />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```
